topic: Food Integrity Agricultural MSP and Nutrition Guarantee Bill

findings.title: Constitution of India, Article 21, Article 47, Seventh Schedule List III Item 33

official_sources.pinpoint: Article 21, Article 47, List III Item 33 (Trade and commerce in foodstuffs)

findings.limitations: Right to life includes right to unadulterated food and basic nutritional security.

gaps: MSP is currently an executive announcement without statutory legal right of procurement.
Widespread food adulteration and pesticide residue markups in local markets.
